messages:
incident-bot: Pager duty: high 5xx rate on /v1/generate from gateway -> runtime. Paging #incidents. Severity: P2. corrid sample: 0a1b2c3d4e. alert links: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/1798743210 :fire:

leila: I'm oncall — looking at gateway metrics. US-WEST-2 spikes, ~2.3% error rate, 502/504s. Seen concurrent retries rising. pulling kv logs now.

mike: adding traces. grabbed a few corrids (0a1b2c3d4e, 1f2e3d4c5b). early clue: long ingress queue time, then backend ECONNRESET/timeout.

james: quick hypothesis: upstream model-host pool hitting connection limits -> gateway retry amplification. X-Retry-Count headers show 2-3 on many failing requests. also saw 503 from runtime at similar timestamps.

leila: customer impact: roughly 1200 failed requests/minute across a handful of customers (dashboard polling + realtime generation flows). Notifying CSMs.

mike: pasting sample log line:
```
2026-03-17T14:53:10Z | corrid=0a1b2c3d4e | route=/v1/generate | service=gateway | upstream=runtime-1 | resp=504 | backend_connect_ms=1200 | retry=1
```

james: timeline so far: 14:50 first small blip, 14:52 ramp to 2% error, 14:53 alert. attaching KV-log bundle to incident dropbox.

leila: mitigation attempt 1: disable gateway retries for /v1/generate (config push in staging -> rolling to prod). command: `infractl routes update --no-retries /v1/generate` — doing canary to 10%.

eva: confirmed canary change applied at ~14:55. early signal: slight reduction in repeat failures (clients not reattempting). still seeing fresh 504s from runtime.

mike: dug into runtime logs for corrid 0a1b2c3d4e: backend shows long GC pause + outlier CPU steal on the host, then connection drop. runtime trace attached: https://kb.redwood/dropbox/trace-0a1b2c3d4e

james: alternative hypothesis: autoscaler slow to add capacity for sudden request size (long seq). also kernel-level connection queue exhaustion observed on one host.

leila: next mitigation: route heavy payloads to model-small fallback for 15m while we stabilize. updating routing policy. `routeset apply --route /v1/generate --fallback model-small --ttl 900s`

mike: rolling pool restart scheduled for runtime-1 host at 15:02 to clear kernel backlogs. will coordinate with SRE.

sre-oncall: taking handoff for post-incident RCA. please upload all KV/log bundles + traces to /incidents/1798743210 and add any missing corrids. I'll run host-level forensics and check autoscaling metrics.

leila: uploaded kvlog tar: https://dropbox.redwood/incidents/1798743210/kvlogs.tar.gz. corrid list included. leaving notes in the runbook. :thumbsup:

eva: customer comms: CSMs informed, status page updated to partial degradation for generation endpoints.

mike: last check at 15:04: error rate down to 0.6% after retries disabled + fallback. keeping incident channel open for RCA artifacts.

sre-oncall: thanks — taking it into RCA. initial likely root: combination of runtime host-level pressure (GC/CPU steal) + gateway retry amplification + slow autoscale reaction. will produce timeline and hypothesis matrix. assigning owners for follow-ups.

leila: noted. I'll write immediate action items (retry gating, safer defaults for heavy payloads, autoscale thresholds) and propose a postmortem doc.

incident-bot: Incident: mitigation successful, monitoring for regression. Closing pager once RCA doc linked. :white_check_mark:
